sys_script_include.description:
MSSOTIQUBE-2578
Script include called by 'HSBC - Trade & Task Migration' will migrate any Trades/Cases/Tasks that meet certain criteria and move them to a Passive table outlined within 'x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_o_hsbc_trade_task_migration_registry' - Logs will be stored here 'x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_o_hsbc_migration_logs_trace'.
sys_script_include.name: HSBC_Trade_and_Task_Migration
